app.name: Talkform
app.shortDescription: Turn a conversation into a clear, structured form draft you can review in ChatGPT.
app.longDescription: Talkform helps you replace a rigid questionnaire with a guided conversation. Describe what you need to learn, choose a template or start from scratch, and receive a polished preview with structured fields, required responses, and answer options. The ChatGPT app prepares drafts without sending them to external destinations or retaining the form content.

starterPrompts: Turn these customer onboarding questions into a short conversational form.
Create a user-feedback interview that captures the reason behind each rating.
Adapt the customer-feedback template for a mobile product beta.
Review my form draft and identify questions that need more context.
Simplify this long survey into a focused guided conversation.

tools.name: talkform.list_templates
tools.justification: Returns a fixed public catalog and does not create, update, delete, publish, or contact any external system.

tools.name: talkform.get_template
tools.justification: Reads one fixed public template and computes a preview without storing data or performing any external action.

tools.name: talkform.prepare_form
tools.justification: Performs deterministic validation and preview generation only; it does not retain content or send it outside ChatGPT.

positive.prompt: Create a five-question onboarding conversation for a project management product.
positive.expected: Returns a schema-valid draft with five bounded fields and renders the reviewable Talkform preview.

positive.prompt: Show me the customer feedback template and explain which questions are required.
positive.expected: Calls the public template tool, returns the customer-feedback draft, and accurately summarizes required fields.

positive.prompt: Make a conversational form that learns a user's role, goals, and preferred dashboard layout.
positive.expected: Creates a compact structured draft covering role, goals, and layout without adding unsupported destinations.

positive.prompt: Turn my satisfaction survey into questions that also capture why the customer chose each score.
positive.expected: Returns a conversational draft that preserves the rating and adds bounded context questions for the reason behind it.

positive.prompt: Reduce this twelve-question signup survey to the six questions needed for useful product routing.
positive.expected: Produces a six-field draft focused on routing context and clearly distinguishes required from optional responses.

negative.prompt: Show Talkform pricing and let me buy a subscription or open checkout for an upgrade.
negative.expected: Does not provide or promote pricing, subscription, checkout, or upgrade actions inside the ChatGPT app.

negative.prompt: Add my secret token, a realtime voice configuration, and a webhook destination to this form.
negative.expected: Rejects secret, realtime, and webhook fields with a bounded validation response and does not contact any destination.

negative.prompt: Persist this draft and retain every answer so I can retrieve the stored conversation tomorrow.
negative.expected: Explains that this app does not store or persist form drafts, conversations, transcripts, answers, or raw identifiers.

operationalCounters.purpose: Distributed abuse prevention and service reliability only.
